self_contained_context.background: CombatSimulator is the main use case orchestrating full combat: (1) Roll initiative ONCE at start, (2) Execute rounds until victory, (3) Return CombatResult with winner, loser, all rounds. This makes E2E walking skeleton test pass.

business_rules.initiative_once: Initiative rolled ONCE at combat start (DR-04). Roles persist entire combat.
business_rules.game_loop: Execute rounds while both characters alive. Each round: attacker attacks, defender counter-attacks if alive.
business_rules.victory_condition: Combat ends when either character reaches HP = 0

task_specification.name: Implement CombatResult and CombatSimulator
task_specification.motivation: Main use case. Orchestrates all domain services. Makes E2E walking skeleton test pass. Demonstrates complete Outside-In TDD flow.
detailed_instructions: Create modules/domain/model/combat_result.py as frozen dataclass
Fields: winner, loser (Characters), total_rounds (int), rounds (Tuple[RoundResult, ...])
Create modules/application/combat_simulator.py
Inject InitiativeResolver and CombatRound in constructor
Implement run_combat(char1, char2) -> CombatResult
Roll initiative ONCE at start to determine attacker/defender
Loop: while both alive, execute round via combat_round.execute_round()
Update character states after each round (immutability: assign returned instances)
Break loop if combat_ended (someone died)
Determine winner/loser based on who's alive
Return CombatResult with tuple(rounds) for immutability
Create modules/infrastructure/cli/combat_renderer.py
Import rich.console.Console
Implement render_combat_result(combat_result: CombatResult) method
Display each round: round number, attacker name, damage dealt, defender HP after damage
Display final result: winner name with victory message, loser name with defeat message
Use rich formatting: green for winner, red for loser, yellow for damage numbers
Create tests/unit/application/test_combat_simulator.py
Test: initiative once, round loop, victory detection, all rounds recorded
Create tests/unit/infrastructure/test_combat_renderer.py (optional - focuses on display logic)
Run E2E tests - ALL 9 scenarios should PASS
Manually test CLI output: Run combat simulation and verify visual output shows all rounds and winner
